forbidden: You do not have permission to see this project's progress.

official.title: Official progress
official.none: No period has been published yet.

live.title: Current progress
live.none: No current value has been computed yet. It is computed when an update is submitted.

intake.explanation: This project entered under way. Its progress starts from the opening position recorded at intake, and each variance runs from that date.

current.title: Progress update in progress
current.none: No progress update is in progress.
current.notActive: Progress is reported once the project is active.
current.startHint: Start the update for the earliest period that has begun. The figures come from the work breakdown and the baseline or, until the project has them, from the figure declared on it.
current.returned: AHDA returned the previous revision of this period:

next.DRAFT: The Project Manager prepares this update and submits it to AHDA.
next.SUBMITTED: Waiting for AHDA to start the review.
next.UNDER_REVIEW: AHDA is reviewing this update. It will be published or returned.
next.RETURNED: Returned to the Project Manager for another revision.

history.title: Progress update history
history.caption: Progress updates, newest first
history.empty: No progress update has been started for this project.

update.prefilled: The narrative and any override are carried over from the last published period. If nothing has changed, submit them as they are.
update.derived: Planned and actual progress are calculated from the baseline and the work breakdown. You cannot type them.
update.overridePercentHint: A number from 0 to 100, with up to four decimal places. The calculated figure is kept and the override is marked.
update.declared: This project has no work breakdown yet, so this is the last figure declared on it. Confirm it, or enter a new one with the reason.
update.noFigure: This project has no work breakdown and no declared figure yet. Enter its progress and say where the figure comes from.
update.stageWeighted: Overall progress is weighed from the stages below: each stage’s weight times its % complete, over the stages that apply.

review.title: Review progress update
review.startConsequence: Taking the update into review lets you publish it or return it. You cannot review an update you submitted.
review.publishConsequence: Publishing makes these figures the period's official record and closes the period. It cannot be changed afterwards.
review.returnConsequence: The Project Manager sees the reason and the period continues as a new draft revision.

done.submitted: The progress update was submitted to AHDA.
done.returned: The progress update was returned for revision.
done.stale: This update changed after you opened it, so nothing was saved. The latest version is shown.

fieldErrors.percentOutOfRange: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with no more than four decimal places.

problems.projectNotActive: Progress is reported on an active project only.
problems.rollupUnavailable: Enter a progress figure: the project has no work breakdown or declared figure yet.
problems.nothingToReport: There is nothing to report: every period that has begun is already published.
problems.submissionExists: An update for this period is already in progress. It is shown below.
problems.notEditable: Only a draft can be changed.
problems.configurationMissing: AHDA has not yet configured the reporting cadence or the health thresholds for this project.
problems.invalidTransition: The update is no longer in a state that allows this.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do this. AHDA reviews progress, and no one reviews an update they submitted.
problems.stagePlanRequired: Set the project’s stage plan first: progress is reported by stage.
problems.stageEntryInvalid: Check the stage progress: each stage that has started needs its actual start, a complete stage its finish, and a lower % than last time its reason.

stages.title: Stage progress
stages.previous: Last published: {percent}. A lower figure needs a reason.
stages.decreaseReason: Why is it lower than last period?
stages.measuredGenerally: Progress is reported by stage. Execution is measured by the schedule once the project has an active baseline; until then it is entered each month.
stages.measuredBySchedule: Execution is measured by the schedule’s active baseline; the other stages are entered each month.
stages.measuredByEntry: Execution is entered each month until the project has an active baseline; then the schedule measures it.
stages.history: Stage progress of each published update
